{{Otheruses|Tribunal}}
A '''Guild Tribunal''' was a form of judiciary assigned by [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Parliament of Guilds]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. When a crime was committed on Cloud City, and the perpetrator caught, they were brought before a Guild Tribunal with a panel of three guild representatives. The guild members were drawn from the guild most associated with the crime; a corrupt [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] dealer would be tried by members of the [[Gambling Guild]], a seller of fake goods by the [[Merchants Guild|Merchant's Guild]], murderers by the [[Security Guild]] or [[Weaponry Guild]]. Arbitrations are fair, even against other guild members due to the Parliament's desire to remain impartial lest judicial authority pass to the [[Exex]] due to perceived biases.
